prediction_text: Main call (single direction): This individual astrologer predicts Donald Trump wins the 2016 US presidential election. Having correctly picked Trump as the Republican nominee when 17 Republicans still contested it, the same forecaster extends the read to the general election: Trump defeats Hillary Clinton on 8 November 2016, against the polls and against the conference panel's majority view. Timing coordinate: forecast reported 8 November 2016, for election day 8 November 2016.
